description: Class representing the collection of table styles of the workbook.

Add.description: Adds a new custom table style to the workbook.

params.description: The name of the new table style. Must be unique among the custom and built-in style names (case-insensitive).
params.name: name

GetCount.description: Returns the number of table styles in the workbook, built-in and custom.

GetItem.description: Returns a table style by its name or by its index. Built-in table, pivot table and slicer styles come first, custom styles last in name order.

params.description: The table style name (case-insensitive; custom styles are searched before built-in ones) or its 1-based index.
params.name: nameOrIndex
